images.caption: MOSCOW. On 21 February 1989 Moscow city and national-territorial electoral district No. 1 of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (RSFSR) held the district\'s pre-electoral assembly in the Hall of Columns in the House of the Unions. At this assembly 10 candidates from Moscow presented and discussed their electoral platforms. The assembly delegates elected first deputy Director of Gosstroi and Minister of the Soviet Union, Boris Yeltsin, as candidate for the Congress of People's Deputies.
images.alt: MOSCOW. On 21 February 1989 Moscow city and national-territorial electoral district No. 1 of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (RSFSR) held the district\'s pre-electoral assembly in the Hall of Columns in the House of the Unions. At this assembly 10 candidates from Moscow presented and discussed their electoral platforms. The assembly delegates elected first deputy Director of Gosstroi and Minister of the Soviet Union, Boris Yeltsin, as candidate for the Congress of People's Deputies.
